scope: Diagnostic validation only; no featurizer training eligibility. Negation was studied historically; new factorial coverage is not new-task discovery. Original whole-task exclusions unchanged.
labels: Binary sentiment convention: really preserves adjective polarity; not reverses expected polarity. This is an operational sentiment contrast, not a claim that linguistic negation universally implements Boolean inversion.
gate: Separately for each format: every valence×modifier cell has>=75% semantic group-choice accuracy and>=50% semantic full-vocab top1; for each factor and each setting of the other factor,>=75% edges have both endpoints correct. Groups inherited unchanged from training panel. Report all cells and failed formats.
stop: One fixed panel. No prompt repair, answer-group expansion, threshold changes or post-result lexical selection. Competence precedes any intended semantic causal supervision.
reserved: All128factorial prompts excluded from fitting. Replays32exact historical controls; no new family added to training.
